tables.title: VLAN insertion or replacement based on VLTI bit
tables.section_title: Source address and VLAN insertion, replacement, or deletion
tables.text_helper: Table 773, "VLAN insertion or replacement based on VLTI bit", in section 76.5.2 (Source address and VLAN insertion, replacement, or deletion) on page 4006. Columns: Condition, Description. 2 data row(s).

rows:
The MAC inserts or replaces the following:
VLAN Type field (C-VLAN or S-VLAN as indicated by the CSVL bit of VLAN inclusion register 
(ETH_MACVIR))
VLAN Tag field with VT field of Transmit context descriptor of the packet

The MAC inserts or replaces the following:
VLAN Type field (C-VLAN or S-VLAN as indicated by the CSVL bit of VLAN inclusion register 
(ETH_MACVIR))
VLAN Tag field with the VLT field of VLAN inclusion register (ETH_MACVIR)
